goal_level_decision_audit.decision: Use RayJoin only as a point-location topology-stream family candidate, not as a full-app pod target.
goal_level_decision_audit.different_path_now: Productize one topology-stream route through the shared runner first, then spend pod time only on a focused runner-vs-legacy comparison.
goal_level_decision_audit.foolish_actions: It would be foolish to run full RayJoin or quote old large OptiX-over-Embree ratios without separating host-boundary sources from routes that are already device resident.
goal_level_decision_audit.other_path: Run the RayJoin pod immediately. That would be faster administratively, but likely repeats RTDBSCAN's failure mode if the selected hot route already removed the host boundary.
goal_level_decision_audit.was_i_foolish: No. This avoids direct pod spend before identifying where a real host-boundary source exists.
